foreground.description: Detailed description of the main subjects visible in the foreground. Do not invent details.

background.description: Detailed description of the background, environment, distant subjects and setting. Sky is NOT part of the background. Do not invent details.

lighting.description: Description of the illumination conditions, including light source, intensity, direction and shadows. Choose exactly one of the allowed values.
enum: Soft, diffuse natural light with subtle shadows
Combination of natural and artificial light
Nighttime with little or no ambient light

weather.description: Description of atmospheric and weather conditions. Choose exactly one of the allowed values.
enum: Clear, with little or no cloud cover
Partly cloudy, with patches of clear sky

cars_visibility.description: One visibility description for each individually distinguishable car visible in the image. Every image contains at least one car. Do not invent cars or count vehicles that cannot be visually identified as cars. Cars include sedans, hatchbacks, station wagons, coupes, convertibles, SUVs, crossovers and passenger-oriented minivans. Exclude buses, heavy trucks, motorcycles, bicycles and specialized industrial or agricultural vehicles. Do not group cars using phrases such as 'multiple cars'.

items.description: Independently assess the car's occlusion and truncation and summarize both. Occlusion means the car is hidden behind another visible object; describe what causes the occlusion. Parts invisible due to orientation or perspective are not occluded. Truncation means the car extends beyond an image boundary. Do not confuse truncation with occlusion. If neither applies, use 'Fully visible'.
examples: Slightly occluded by a tree and partially truncated
